system.description:
FOCUS SHADOW TECHNIQUE Actions Reaction; Trigger you are targeted by an attack which you are aware of.

You create illusory afterimages of yourself that blur your exact location. This grants you the concealed condition until the beginning of your next turn.

Automated: when an attack targets you, you are asked before it is rolled (with your other reactions). A yes spends your reaction and this use, and makes you Concealed until the start of your next turn (6 seconds out of combat).
